description: This Java source file defines a WearableListenerService named ListenerService that handles data and message events from wearable devices, such as receiving updates about tourism attractions and clearing notifications. It manages showing notifications with images and intents to launch activities, and communicates with Google Play Services APIs.

classes.name: ListenerService
classes.description: An Android WearableListenerService that handles data changes and messages from connected wearable devices, displaying notifications and managing communication.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles data change events received from wearable devices, triggers notification display when relevant data updates occur.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming message events to clear notifications when a specific message path is received.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Constructs and displays a notification on the device with attraction details and an image, also sets up intents for user interaction.
